rationale: The most recent 1-minute candles show a clear deterioration: after consolidating tightly around $44.47–$44.48, the last bar broke down to close at $44.36 on the highest volume since entry (4,249 shares), pushing price below the 9-EMA ($44.36) and within $0.16 of the invalidation level at $44.20. Maximum favorable excursion remains zero — the trade has never moved in our favor — and the momentum that justified the entry (staircase of higher closes, buying pressure) has reversed. With the invalidation likely to be hit imminently and no evidence of a bounce, closing now preserves capital rather than waiting for an automatic stop-out at a slightly worse price.
